text:
maggie: heads up - onboarding for tenant `pinecrest` is failing in SCIM create_user. API returns 400 invalid displayName bytes and we see KMS unwrap errors. repro in staging.

tony: paste logs? prod or staging?

maggie: staging logs:
```
2024-02-28T11:02:03Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=pinecrest POST /scim/v2/Users 400 {\"detail\":\"invalid displayName bytes\"}
2024-02-28T11:02:03Z kms-client WARN tenant=pinecrest unwrap: invalid header
```

li: "invalid header" often == envelope format mismatch or alias rewrap mismatch. any KMS alias changes recently?

tony: infra shows a partial alias migration to `alias/redwood-pinecrest-v2` yesterday but config still points at `alias/redwood-pinecrest`. possible half-migration.

maggie: also seeing IdP (Okta) sending decomposed unicode for some names (NFD). example bytes: emoji + decomposed accent. serializer then rewrap changed header bytes.

security-bot: [audit] scim-provisioning-failure tenant=pinecrest incident=INC-20240228-9

li: quick mitigation: 1) pause alias migration for tenant; 2) add NFC normalization in SCIM adapter pipeline to ensure stable byte representation before envelope creation; 3) fallback RBAC mapping to email/externalId when displayName lookup fails.

tony: agree. add regression test for unicode normalization in scim-harness. i'll coordinate KMS ops to rollback the partial rewrap in staging.

maggie: applied NFC normalization on staging and repro now succeeds. will schedule a short maintenance window for prod patch and vendor sign-off for KMS.

ops-bot: deploy queued: scim-adapter nfc-normalize patch -> staging.

li: long-term: stop relying on displayName for role mapping; use externalId/email/group IDs. create RFC and migration plan.

maggie: filing postmortem + follow-up tickets for RBAC migration and KMS rewrap audit. thanks all. :thumbsup:
